title: Shared building blocks of the aviation profile aviation.v1

subject.description: Subject identifier, 32 bytes hexadecimal - the same format as the subj field in the entry.

timestamp.description: Point in time in the real world, RFC 3339 with time zone.

party.description: Party involved. Names of natural persons do not belong in here; the profile knows only operations (spec Sec.8).

quantity.description: Quantity with a unit per UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20, e.g. H87 (pieces).

product.description: One aircraft part, always instance-level (spec Sec.3).

serial_number.description: The part's own serial number - the subject's real-world identity.

certificate_ref.description: The 8130-3 / EASA Form 1 tracking number of the certificate this entry concerns.

approval_type.description: Which kind of organization issued that certificate (spec Sec.7).

cycle_limit.description: The life limit in flight cycles, only meaningful when life_limited is true.

cycles_used.description: Cumulative flight cycles as of this entry (spec Sec.5).

item.description: Reference to another subject, optionally with quantity and part details.
